page_title: BOL 2-0 ROM | Bologna v AS Roma 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is flagged for offside.
88' Substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers makes way for Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
88' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lewis Ferguson.
87' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
82' Jose Mourinho decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Mancini will be replaced by Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
81' Substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) has come on for Lorenzo Pellegrini.

80' Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Federico Ravaglia anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
79' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
79' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:4.
75' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) replaces Victor Kristiansen.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nikola Moro leaves the pitch and Michel Aebischer (Bologna) comes on.
74' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
73' Flag goes up against Dan Ndoye (Bologna) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
72' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) picks up a yellow card.
71' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
69' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' The fouls committed statistics – 11:11.
66' This is a yellow card! Remo Freuler (Bologna) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
66' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
64' A substitution has been made. Renato Sanches is replaced by Edoardo Bove (AS Roma).
64' Jose Mourinho has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) replacing Diego Llorente.
62' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
60' This shall not pass! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
59' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
58' Substitution. Sam Beukema did his best and is replaced by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna).
57' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
56' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
55' The shots on goal statistics – 2:2.
52' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from AS Roma.
49' 2 - 0 Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
47' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Here is a change. Leonardo Spinazzola is going off and Jose Mourinho gives the last tactical orders to Renato Sanches (AS Roma).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Marco Guida has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45+1' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
44' Joshua Zirkzee provides the assist in the box, but Dan Ndoye (Bologna) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
42' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
42' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
41' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
40' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

39' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Dan Ndoye finds Nikola Moro (Bologna) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
36' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
34' Marco Guida blows his whistle after Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
33' Sam Beukema (Bologna) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

32' The corner is slung over and Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
32' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) prepares to take a corner kick.

31' Federico Ravaglia makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Andrea Belotti (AS Roma) after a cross from the side. The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
30' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
27' The resulting corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) comes to nothing.
26' 67:33 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
25' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' Neat passing move from Bologna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
19' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna).
18' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
12' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
11' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
11' AS Roma are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) is booked.
9' The game is interrupted. Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
7' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
6' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
4' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Marco Guida signals a foul.
1' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Bologna will kick-off.
